import unittest

from src.quantities import total_units
from src.orders import order_summary
from src.exports import export_row


class QuantityTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_empty_and_zero(self):
        self.assertEqual(total_units([]), 0)
        self.assertEqual(total_units([{"quantity": 0}]), 0)

    def test_list_is_not_modified(self):
        items = [{"quantity": 2}, {"quantity": 3}]
        self.assertEqual(total_units(items), 5)
        self.assertEqual(items, [{"quantity": 2}, {"quantity": 3}])

    def test_one_shot_iterator(self):
        self.assertEqual(total_units(iter([{"quantity": 2}, {"quantity": 3}])), 5)

    def test_public_shapes(self):
        self.assertEqual(order_summary([{"quantity": 2}]), {"total_units": 2, "status": "preview"})
        self.assertEqual(export_row([{"quantity": 2}]), "units,2")
